verdict.rationale: Convex's own CLI watches local files and pushes schema changes to the dev deployment, so schema definitions live as code that can be version-controlled ([convex-docs-17], [convex-docs-50]). Schemas are optional and tables are created implicitly, though ([convex-docs-3], [convex-docs-43]). Nothing in the evidence shows explicit migration files, data-migration tooling, or CI/production deploy flows. missing for 10: versioned migration mechanism, data migration tooling for schema changes, CLI/CI deploy to production, independent corroboration.
